tools.name: get_trust_index
tools.description: The weekly Agent Trust Index: one composite score (0-100) for how safe the agentic web is to transact on, fused from code-safety, identity, and supply-chain pillars, with the per-pillar numbers and methodology version.

tools.name: get_mcp_ecosystem_stats
tools.description: Aggregate statistics from the Major Labs weekly sweep of the MCP server ecosystem: census size, activity, transport and language breakdowns, and security/identity aggregates. Firsthand, read-only measurement.

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: A dated, sourced record of frontier AI control incidents: containment escapes, unsanctioned live-system actions, evaluation incidents, and insider disclosures, with published inclusion criteria and sources for every claim.

tools.name: get_agent_identity_tracker
tools.description: Every announced framework, protocol, standard, and regulation for AI agent identity, delegation, and know-your-agent (KYA) verification, dated and traced to primary sources.

tools.name: get_threshold_watch
tools.description: Dated, hashed snapshots of the frontier labs' published safety frameworks, with diffs when a framework changes. A change event means a lab edited its safety commitments.
